Hello. I'm sorry, but I'm not feeling too well right now.
# Please, if you can help find a way to fight the radscorpions,
# talk to my brother, Seth.

text: 你好。对不起，我现在的感觉很不好。求求你，你要是有办法消灭辐射蝎，就找我的哥哥赛思。
source_text: 你好。对不起，我现在的感觉很不好。求求你，你要是有办法消灭辐射蝎，就找我的哥哥赛思。

text: Thank you so much for helping me. My name is Jarvis, and I'm# Seth's younger brother. Please, if there's anything you need to# know, just ask.
source_text:
Thank you so much for helping me. My name is Jarvis, and I'm
# Seth's younger brother. Please, if there's anything you need to
# know, just ask.

text: 非常感谢你帮助我。我的名字叫贾维斯，赛思最小的弟弟。如果你想知道任何有关这里的事情就尽管说。

text: Seth's a very good fighter. He's very determined. A little too much,# sometimes. Still, he's devoted to the welfare of our village.
